title: Tensor presentation of continuous module pullback on independently sized sites
statement: Let C and D be sites essentially small relative to a coefficient universe w [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let F:D -> C be continuous, and let L:Sh(D,Type w) -> Sh(C,Type w) be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint to continuous direct image. For commutative ring sheaves R on C and S on D, and a ring map phi:S -> F_*R, there exist an algebraic inverse image I of S with ring RI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], a ring map c:RI -> R, and an additive module functor T whose objects and maps are exactly sheafified scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] of I.modules, with an adjunction T left adjoint to continuous module direct image along phi, using restriction of scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Site object and morphism universes are independent of w.

source.place: Morphisms of topoi and sheaves of modules: lemmas pullback-module, adjoint-push-pull-modules and adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules; sheafified scalar-extension adjunction, Tag 03D7.

proof.text: Construct the continuous ringed direct image and transpose the given coefficient map using the set-sheaf adjunction. Ring and module graph identities follow by transposing products and constants.

Use the algebraic presentation of the finite-limit-preserving set inverse image to construct the transported ring and module functor. Its underlying set isomorphism transports the structural ring map. Reflect the addition, multiplication and unit identities through the inverse ring isomorphism to obtain a ring homomorphism c.

Restrict the set-sheaf Hom equivalence to linear maps. The graph equations and compatibility of binary operations with mates establish linearity in both directions and naturality. Compose this equivalence with the sheafified tensor/restriction adjunction. The resulting left adjoint is additive. Its objects and maps are literally scalar extension of the algebraic inverse-image functor.

proof_origin.place: Module inverse image and scalar extension
proof_origin.note: Generalizes the existing proved private supplied_adjunction and siteContinuousRingedTopos arguments to independent site universes, retaining the actual objects, maps and continuous direct image.

lean.statement:
theorem continuous_ringed_pullback_presentation
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u} C] [EssentiallySmall.{u} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    [K.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (F : D ⥤ C) [F.IsContinuous K J]
    (L : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u))
    (adj : L ⊣ F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) K J) [PreservesFiniteLimits L]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (S : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (φ : S ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} K J).obj R) :
    ∃ (RI : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (I : AlgebraicInverseImage L S RI) (c : RI ⟶ R)
      (T : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj S) ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) (_ : T.Additive),
      ∃ hobj : ∀ M, T.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M),
      (∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), T.map a =
        eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫
          eqToHom (hobj N).symm) ∧
      Nonempty (T ⊣ SheafOfModules.pushforward
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φ))
